title: Vigia Mais MT facial recognition identifies a woman wanted for drug trafficking in downtown Cuiabá; Ciosp tracks her in real time and the 1st Military Police Battalion arrests her
summary: Diário de Cuiabá (14 Jul 2025): Sesp-MT's Vigia Mais MT cameras matched a woman with a June 2024 trafficking warrant in central Cuiabá on 12 July; Ciosp tracked her live and the 1st BPM arrested her.
account: On Saturday 12 July 2025 the video-monitoring system of Mato Grosso's State Secretariat of Public Security (Sesp), through the Vigia Mais MT program, helped arrest a woman with an open warrant for drug trafficking in downtown Cuiabá, according to the same text carried by Diário de Cuiabá and O Documento on 14 July and CliqueF5 on 15 July 2025. Cameras in the city center identified her by facial recognition; after the system confirmed her identity, the monitoring center of the Integrated Public Security Operations Center (Ciosp) tracked her movements in real time and passed them to a team of the 1st Military Police Battalion, which made the approach. Her warrant had been issued on 19 June 2024 by the 9th Criminal Court Specialized in Drug Offenses, and she was taken to a Civil Judicial Police unit. The reports add that from April to July 2025 about 60 fugitives were located and arrested by state security forces.
purpose: Vigia Mais MT is the state's video-monitoring program whose facial recognition compares faces seen on public cameras with wanted persons so that Ciosp can direct patrols to them; locating a person with an open warrant is that purpose.
system: Vigia Mais MT video-monitoring facial recognition (Sesp-MT / Ciosp)
deployer: Secretaria de Estado de Segurança Pública de Mato Grosso (Sesp-MT), through the Centro Integrado de Operações de Segurança Pública (Ciosp)
segment: Public-space facial recognition against warrant lists

ratings.reason: Sesp-MT's Ciosp located a woman wanted since a 19 June 2024 warrant, tracked her in real time and handed her to the 1st Military Police Battalion, which arrested her, per the 14 July 2025 reports; a measurable result for the unit.
One person with an open drug-trafficking warrant was taken into custody; the reports give no evidence of any further harm prevented, so the public benefit is the execution of a warrant.

ai_role.statement: The reports credit the facial recognition system with the identification: cameras in central Cuiabá matched her face and the system confirmed her identity, after which Ciosp operators tracked her and a Military Police team made the arrest. The sources do not name the vendor, the algorithm or any match score, and they come from a single text that reads as the state's release.
